summary: Frontend-only mobile UX regression + CTA audit for UPSCAPE. Tested the four reported mobile bug fixes (hamburger close button, mobile nav text size, brand logo scroll-to-top, hero/section H1 scaling) plus a full CTA/anchor route audit. 24/24 assertions passed on live preview URL at 390x844 and 1440x900 viewports.

issues: The CookieBanner (data-testid='cookie-banner') overlaps the bottom of the enquiry modal on mobile (390x844). It also intercepts pointer events on buttons near the viewport bottom (observed when trying to click final-quote). Consider auto-dismissing or hiding the cookie banner while a modal is open, or stacking the modal above it (higher z-index + pointer-events).

action_items: Address cookie banner overlapping/intercepting modal + bottom-of-page CTAs on mobile. Either (a) raise the enquiry-modal z-index above the cookie-banner and block banner pointer events while a modal is open, or (b) auto-collapse the banner when a modal opens.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx handleNav currently calls setOpen(false) for non-anchor links but the Link onClick already closes it — minor redundancy, not a bug.
Mobile overlay has paddingTop:80 inline — the mobile-menu-close button sits at top-4 right-5 which is above the content pad; works, but inline style vs Tailwind class is inconsistent.
CookieBanner has no z-index coordination with modal (z-[80]). Consider moving cookie-banner to a lower z-index (e.g., z-40) or hiding it when any dialog is open.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All reported mobile fixes verified on live preview: mobile-menu-close button is visible+working, m-nav-* items render at 24px (text-2xl), brand-logo scrolls to top on '/' and navigates home from '/about', hero H1 is 40px with no horizontal overflow at 390 viewport, all CTAs (hero-wa-cta, hero-quote-cta, header-whatsapp, header-quote, m-whatsapp, m-quote, final-wa, final-quote, wa-float) have correct wa.me/971542197974 href or open enquiry-modal. All routes (/, /about, /contact, /services/painting, /case-studies/damac-hills-handover-programme) return 200. Only non-critical UX issue: cookie banner overlaps modal footer on mobile.
rca of the issue: N/A — mobile fixes verified working. The one playwright click timeout at the end of the run was caused by the cookie banner (z-index/pointer-events) intercepting clicks on bottom-of-page CTAs, not a product regression. The CTAs themselves have correct href/handlers.
